findings.title: Claim form amount does not match bill total plus pharmacy bills
findings.detail: The claim form amount claimed (44018.19) does not equal the sum of the hospital bill total payable (43180.19) and the pharmacy bill (838.00), which totals 44018.19.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill outside hospital stay dates
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is dated 22 Oct 2024, but the pharmacy is located in Noida while the hospital is in Kolkata, and the bill references external medicine purchases outside the hospital stay.
